#!/bin/sh
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
response=$(
  timeout -s 3 $1 \
  redis-cli \
    -h localhost \
    -p $REDIS_PORT \
    ping
)
if [ "$response" != "PONG" ]; then
  echo "$response"
  exit 1
fi

#!/bin/sh
export REDISCLI_AUTH="$REDIS_PASSWORD"
response=$(
  timeout -s 3 $1 \
  redis-cli \
    -h localhost \
    -p $REDIS_PORT \
    ping
)
if [ "$response" != "PONG" ] && [ "$response" != "LOADING Redis is loading the dataset in memory" ]; then
  echo "$response"
  exit 1
fi

It integrates with a variety of DNS providers, such as CloudFlare DNS, Amazon Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, and more, to ensure that your applications are easily accessible from anywhere with a DNS name. With ExternalDNS, you can simplify the process of managing DNS records for your home lab, eliminating the need for manual updates and reducing the risk of errors.
